2607.05830.title: Decision-Focused Scenario Generation and Selection for Efficient and Robust Grid Dispatch
2607.05830.paper_summary: The increasing uncertainty from flexible demand and renewable generation has made distributionally robust optimization (DRO) an important tool for robust power system dispatch. DRO relies on forecast scenarios to construct ambiguity sets, but conventional scenario generation pipelines are often trained in an accuracy-oriented manner and may neglect spatial correlations among uncertainties. This mismatch can produce ambiguity sets that are statistically plausible but suboptimal for downstream operation. This work proposes a decision-focused generative framework for correlated scenario generation in DRO-based dispatch. Instead of training generative models solely to fit the historical uncertainty distribution, the proposed framework optimizes generated scenarios according to their induced downstream operational cost. The proposed framework is tailored to mainstream generative models, including variational autoencoders, generative adversarial networks, and diffusion models, while capturing the joint distribution of uncertainties across buses. To improve computational tractability, we further develop a differentiable scenario selector that selects decision-relevant scenarios from a generated pool and can be trained within the same decision-focused pipeline. Case studies demonstrate that the proposed framework effectively reduces 0.80%-2.02% operational cost across different generative models compared to accuracy-oriented methods.
2607.05830.paper_summary_zh: 隨著靈活需求和可再生能源發電的不確定性增加，分佈式穩健優化（DRO）已成為穩健電力系統調度的重要工具。DRO依賴預測情境來構建模糊集，但傳統的情境生成管道通常以準確性為導向進行訓練，可能忽略不確定性之間的空間相關性。這種不匹配可能產生在統計上合理但對下游操作來說不最佳的模糊集。本研究提出了一種針對DRO基礎調度中相關情境生成的決策聚焦生成框架。該框架不僅僅是為了擬合歷史不確定性分佈而訓練生成模型，而是根據所生成情境所引起的下游操作成本進行優化。所提出的框架專為主流生成模型量身定制，包括變分自編碼器、生成對抗網絡和擴散模型，同時捕捉跨母線的不確定性聯合分佈。為了提高計算可行性，我們進一步開發了一個可微分的情境選擇器，該選擇器從生成的池中選擇與決策相關的情境，並可以在同一決策聚焦管道中進行訓練。案例研究表明，與以準確性為導向的方法相比，所提出的框架有效地減少了不同生成模型下的0.80%-2.02%的操作成本。
